document: v0.7 exploratory analysis plan (fold-9 development matrix; write-once, written before the first v0.7 training run)
status: EXPLORATORY: no setting may be chosen, changed or re-run based on any v0.7 number
locked_stage_plan_v0.7: EXPLORATORY development matrix on fold 9: 2 architectures (resnet1d_wang, inception1d) x 3 arms (signal_only, signal_plus_physio, signal_plus_all) x 3 seeds (42, 123, 2024) at the locked lr 0.01; training on folds 1-8, fold-9 evaluation once at the end of epoch 50; recipe, folds 1-8 encoder (widths 256/259/338), age scaler and lead normalization exactly as dev_protocol.json, v0.5_training_details.json and the v0.5 code. Reused, NOT retrained (sha256-verified against v0.5_manifest.json, file sha256 59968bfb50d8c919de0e8004ef878a44a115560de438b7e74582877495e95f87; per-file hashes in v0.7_reused_v0.5_files): v0.5 resnet1d_wang signal_plus_physio seed 42 lr 0.01, v0.5 inception1d signal_plus_physio seed 42 lr 0.01, v0.5 resnet1d_wang signal_only seed 42 lr 0.01 -> 15 new runs. Status: EXPLORATORY; no setting may be chosen or changed from it. Known bias: lr was selected on fold 9 with signal_plus_physio, so on fold 9 the physio - signal_only delta is biased UPWARD and the all - physio delta DOWNWARD.
training: verbatim v0.5 train_run with the documented changes: FORBIDDEN_ARM guard removed; lr = SELECTED_LR[arch]; after epoch 50: predict_fold9 -> save state_dict, train-loss CSV, probability CSV (atomic rename) -> log 'completed' with sha256 of the three files -> compute AUROC; head first-Linear widths 256/259/338 and OneCycle total_steps 6850 asserted; recipe = dev_protocol.json + v0.5_training_details.json
crash_and_rerun_rule_locked: a run may be re-run from scratch with the same seed only if it crashed or produced a non-finite training loss BEFORE its fold-9 evaluation; a run whose fold-9 evaluation was computed is never re-run; every attempt (including failed ones) is logged in the v0.7 manifest
crash_and_rerun_rule_implementation: append-only OUT_DIR/v0.7_attempt_log.jsonl: 'started' before a run, 'completed' (sha256 of probs/loss/state) after its files are saved, 'failed' (error message) on any exception or non-finite loss, then the exception is re-raised. On re-execution: probability CSV exists -> run COMPLETE, never re-run, hashes verified against the 'completed' entry (if none: accept, log 'completed_recovered', WARN); no probability CSV and the log shows started/failed -> delete partial files of that run (logged as 'deleted_partial_files') and re-run from scratch with the same seed as attempt n+1; at most 2 attempts per run, then STOP and report without changing any setting.

analyses.E1: per-run table: arch, arm, seed, reused (bool), macro-AUROC, 5 per-class AUROCs, final-epoch train loss (reused runs: from their v0.5 loss CSV), wall time, peak VRAM (reused: from lr_selection.json table / v0.5_manifest.json sanity_gate, else NaN). Saved as v0.7_runs_table.csv.
analyses.E2: seed summary per (arch, arm): mean, SD (ddof=1), min, max of macro-AUROC over the 3 seeds. Saved as v0.7_seed_summary.csv.
analyses.E3: seed ensemble per (arch, arm): P_ens = arithmetic mean of the 3 seeds' probabilities per record and class; macro- and per-class AUROC. Saved as v0.7_ensemble_table.csv and v0.7_ensemble_{arch}_{arm}_fold9_probs.csv (ecg_id, patient_id, 5 probabilities).
analyses.E4: paired patient-level bootstrap on fold 9 with the reference implementation only: _pat9, _rows9 = REF['patient_rows_in_file_order'](fold-9 patient_id as int64); BOOT9 = REF['build_boot_idx'](len(_pat9), 2000, 7); assert len(_pat9) == 1942. Closed list (delta = B - A), for EACH architecture: C1 = signal_plus_all - signal_plus_physio; C2 = signal_plus_physio - signal_only. Each comparison (a) on the seed-ensemble probabilities [primary for v0.7] and (b) per seed (same seed in both arms) [secondary]; REF['paired_bootstrap'] and REF['summarize_deltas'] (point on the full fold 9, 95% and 90% percentile CIs, NaN-draw count); for (a) also per-class point deltas and 95% CIs from class_delta; SD (ddof=1) of the 3 per-seed point deltas. Saved as v0.7_bootstrap_summary.csv (arch x comparison x {ensemble, seed42, seed123, seed2024}) and v0.7_bootstrap_deltas_ensemble.csv (2000 x 4: arch x comparison). REF['h3_verdict'] is NOT called; no verdict string, no a/b/material flag and no 'within +/-0.01' label is computed or printed for fold 9.
analyses.E5: lr was selected on fold 9 with signal_plus_physio (seed 42): on fold 9, C2 (physio - signal_only) is biased UPWARD and C1 (all - physio) is biased DOWNWARD. Fold 10 (v0.9) is not affected. EXPLORATORY.
analyses.E6: untrained-column note: the fold-9 records that map to an all-zero training column (site=__UNKNOWN__) under the folds 1-8 encoder are reported as a COUNT only and asserted == 2 (final_run_protocol locked_quantities); no sensitivity analysis.
analyses.E7: plausibility (WARN only, never stop, never retrain): any signal_only or signal_plus_physio run with fold-9 macro-AUROC < 0.90; any run whose final-epoch train loss is > 2x the median of the same arch.
analyses.closed_list: Anything not in E1-E7 is not computed in v0.7.

self_sha256_procedure: Load the JSON file; remove the key 'self_sha256' (the key must be absent, not empty); serialize the remaining dict with json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')); compute SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes; the hex digest must equal the stored 'self_sha256'. (At write time numpy scalars were converted to plain JSON types first, so the loaded file hashes identically.)
